covered:
LENS: the honesty of M7's tests, on commit 2940233 (detached in the worktree /home/user/I99/.claude/worktrees/wf_99cd96aa-b0b-4; nothing in the repository was edited, `git status` is empty at the end; /home/user/I99 was not touched). Everything I wrote is in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-tests/ (index: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-tests/README.txt). Mutants ran only on archive copies (git archive 2940233, imported), with a user:// of their own.

READ: docs/CLAUDE.md; GDD 1.4, 10.2 to 10.5, 18, 18.1 (and 5.6, 6.5, 7.3, 7.4, 7.7, 9.6, 11.4 where a check pointed there); DECISIONS D-046 to D-050 (and D-031); the four entries of tests/tests.json; all 2,624 lines of tests/test_boss.gd; tests/support/cabin_suite.gd, test_suite.gd; tests/run_tests.gd; the scripted driver of tests/test_run.gd (585-792) and T-RUN-01's checks of the bosses; the owed checks in test_items.gd 1485-1505, test_deals.gd 45-60, test_phantom.gd 195-236; all of src/core/boss_sim.gd, car_sim.gd, collision.gd, hand_sim.gd, suspicion_sim.gd, run_generator.gd, clock_sim.gd; the boss parts of drive_sim.gd, item_sim.gd, leg_sim.gd, leg_generator.gd; tools/mutants.py and its three lists (156 mutants; not re-run).

RAN: (0) Baseline of the four tests: PASS, 1240 / 1803 / 7046 / 96 checks.
(1) CLAUSE BY CLAUSE: every clause of the four passes_when texts and every sentence of GDD 10.2 to 10.5 has at least one check that can fail; what is missing lies at edges and seams (findings 5 to 17). Established nowhere in the suite: GDD 9.6's tea-stall sign, built in M7 (finding 4). 'About 90 s' exists only as par_s = 90 in data: a cleanly driven Checkpoint took 75.4 s (99.2 s with a Long queue; its queue phase 46.2 s against 70.0 s, +52%), which I did not make a finding.
(2) MUTATION: 91 new one-line mutants in two lists (72 + 19; results in results_first_list.txt and results_second_list.txt of my folder), each run against its nearest test and, when it lived, against the other three: 33 killed, 1 hung T-BOSS-01 (#80), 57 alive. Two more changes ran against all 114 tests (both alive: finding 4), one against T-BOSS-01 to show a hang (finding 19), three survivors against T-RUN/T-REPLAY/T-SAVE/T-CLOCK/T-STOP or T-PHANTOM. Of the 57 survivors 46 are in findings 1 and 5 to 17. Eleven make no difference to play: #7 (first in line while the vehicle just waved on is still under the bar: the Stow starts a second or two sooner; D-048's wording does not count that vehicle); #20, #21, #64 (stop() leaves bar_at, the corridor, call_taken set: every boss ends in a save point that rebuilds the simulation in the same tick); #22 (clear_m ignored: the leaver outruns the creep, the next starts about half a second sooner); #41 (a Night leg's cramp, not M7's: T-PHANTOM-01 kills it); #51 (the plan's line between the barriers: nothing for the player, see finding 16); #58 (sideways speed kept after a barrier touch: steering rebuilds it within a quarter second); #63 (the checkpoint's sign stays in the snapshot when behind him: I did not check what the view does with it); #66 (parked for the Call the wrist steers fully: the car stands); #71 (dawn_phase never 3 in the snapshot: only the debug HUD reads the value). #92 is the fix of finding 2 applied as a change: the four tests pass with it as without it.
(3) APPENDED CHECKS, tried on copies only: 34 functions `_check_review_*` in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-tests/appended_checks.gd.txt. 31 pass on 2940233 (the four tests then make 1435 / 1820 / 7067 / 106 checks: appended_run5.log there); the other three fail and are findings 1 to 3 (appended_run6_all.log). 43 of the 46 survivors were run one by one against the strengthened tests and are killed (results_appended_checks_kill.txt). Not shown killed: #6 (its check fails on the build as it is), #83 and #89 (no check written).
(4) PROBES (godot --headless --path <worktree> --script): probe_vacuous.gd, probe_patrol_rows.gd, probe_stow_patrol.gd, probe_tea_sign.gd, probe_seams.gd, probe_pullover.gd, probe_key.gd in my folder. probe_pullover.gd shows that what T-CALL-01 sets by hand for the fourth response is reachable through the inputs alone (4.0 to 5.3 s of the 8 s ring), so that shortcut is not a finding.

NOT CHECKED: the views (no display); the whole suite against every survivor (only the two of finding 4; #18, #53, #41 against a part); a Wreck inside a boss, which no M7 test tries; the phone Habit's calls during Noor's Call. UNVERIFIED (left out of the findings): while boss.holds_car() skips car.step, car.edge_touched keeps its last value, so a barrier touched on the very tick he becomes first in line would scrape again every 0.8 s while he is held; I could not bring that tick about through play. The machine ran at a load of 16 to 21 all session, so the wall times in the logs are three to four times the usual; test results do not depend on them.

findings.title: A vehicle waved on at the Checkpoint is deleted in mid-road about 66 m past the bar, and no check follows it
findings.where: /home/user/I99/.claude/worktrees/wf_99cd96aa-b0b-4/src/core/boss_sim.gd:644-646 (_step_queue: `if _waved_on[lane] != null: _traffic.remove(_waved_on[lane])`); /home/user/I99/.claude/worktrees/wf_99cd96aa-b0b-4/tests/test_boss.gd:130-163 and 887-902 (the queue is watched only up to the bar)
findings.gdd: D-048: 'The one at the bar is served for 4 s and leaves at up to 40 km/h'. D-050: 'another lane's is up while a vehicle that was waved on drives under it'. GDD 10.2, phase 1: 'Stop-and-go in first gear between concrete barriers'.
findings.evidence: Probe /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-tests/probe_vacuous.gd, part B (he stands at 5 m and watches the middle lane; bar at 350 m, road ends at 500 m): 'vehicle 7 (waved_on) left the road at s = 416.4 m, 66.4 m past the bar, t = 11.8 s', then vehicles 8 to 11 at 416.4 to 418.0 m (t = 19.9, 27.9, 35.7, 43.7 s); only the last one, 12, drives out: 502.2 m at 59.3 s. The check written for it, _check_review_waved_on_drive_off, FAILS on 2940233: 'every vehicle waved on drives off to the end of the Checkpoint's road (vanished on the way, at: 414 m, 416 m, 416 m, 414 m, 416 m)' (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-tests/appended_run6_all.log). Mutant #6 (`elif gone.s - gone.half_length > _length:` -> `elif true:`, the vehicle vanishes 4 m past the bar) lives: all four tests pass.
findings.failure: Waiting in the queue, the player watches each car that was let through drive off and blink out of existence some 65 m beyond the bar at the moment the next one is waved on: five of every six, in all three lanes, in daylight.
findings.fix: Keep every leaver on the road until its tail has passed the end of the Checkpoint's road: a list of leavers per lane in place of the one slot `_waved_on[lane]`, and drop lines 644-645. Append _check_review_waved_on_drive_off (every waved-on vehicle is on the road until s - half_length > length; its speed never above leave_kmh).

findings.title: A lane line crossed without indicating costs +20 Suspicion at the Checkpoint: one of the Patrol's rows applies there, and T-BOSS-01 tries only two of the seven
findings.where: /home/user/I99/.claude/worktrees/wf_99cd96aa-b0b-4/src/core/drive_sim.gd:455-456 (the only suspicion.add outside _step_suspicion, which is where the Checkpoint shuts the Patrol's rows out); /home/user/I99/.claude/worktrees/wf_99cd96aa-b0b-4/tests/test_boss.gd:79-88
findings.gdd: D-048: 'the Patrol's rows of GDD 6.5 do not apply, only the Checkpoint's own'. GDD 6.5, table 'Behaviour during a Patrol': 'Crossing a lane line without indicating | +20'.
findings.evidence: Probe /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-tests/probe_patrol_rows.gd: 'a lane line crossed without indicating, 20 m into the Checkpoint's road: Suspicion 0.0 -> 20.0 (suspicion_lane_cross is 20)'; 'the same with the indicator on: Suspicion 0.0'; a sip of the flask there: 0.0 (that row is kept out). Lines 79-88 of the test try fourth gear and the horn only. The appended check _check_review_lane_line_at_checkpoint FAILS on 2940233: 'a lane line crossed without indicating adds nothing: expected 0.0 within 0.000001, got 20.0'. And the four tests cannot tell either way: with the fix applied as a change (#92 of my second list) all four pass, as they do without it.
findings.failure: On the 140 m of open three-lane road before the barriers the player picks a queue. Each lane change without the indicator silently adds 20; two of them and one touch of a barrier (25) make 65: he is searched and loses his contraband for something no rule of the Checkpoint names.
findings.fix: drive_sim.gd:455: `if items.indicator != signi(lane - _lane) and boss.kind != BossSim.CHECKPOINT:`. Append _check_review_lane_line_at_checkpoint next to the two rows already tried.

findings.title: Putting contraband away in the glovebox while a Patrol watches is counted as 'using contraband in view': +40
findings.where: /home/user/I99/.claude/worktrees/wf_99cd96aa-b0b-4/src/core/item_sim.gd:713-715 (complete(): any ritual of an item marked contraband sets contraband_used; the shared `stow` ritual of M7 is such a ritual). No test stows in view of a Patrol.
findings.gdd: GDD 6.5: 'Using contraband in view | +40', and of the fine: 'visible contraband is taken' (hiding it is the defence). D-048: 'What is in a cell is out of use'. GDD 7.7: forged papers are 'contraband until used'. (D-031, written in M4 before there was a stow ritual: 'Contraband and the phone count when a ritual of an item marked contraband ... completes'; read to the letter with D-048 it gives this result, which is why I mark it for the owner.)
findings.evidence: Probe /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-tests/probe_stow_patrol.gd (a Patrol leg, the police car watching, the glovebox open, the item dragged to it by the hand): 'stow the flask while a Patrol watches: Suspicion 0.0 -> 38.5 (suspicion_contraband is 40); stowed now: true; ritual_completed stow'; 'stow forged papers while a Patrol watches: Suspicion 0.0 -> 38.5'; 'take it out again while a Patrol watches: Suspicion 0.0 -> 0.0'. (38.5 is 40 less 0.3 s of driving clean.) The appended check _check_review_stow_in_view_of_a_patrol FAILS on 2940233 for both items: 'putting it away in the glovebox is not using it: no Suspicion (38.5)'.
findings.failure: The player who sees the blue light and hides the flask, or the forged papers, which have no use at all, is charged as if he had drunk from it; from 62 Suspicion up, hiding it is what pulls him over. Taking it out again under the same eyes is free.
findings.fix: In ItemSim.complete() do not count the `stow` ritual as a use (`and GameData.as_string(ritual.get('id')) != 'stow'`), or record in DECISIONS that hiding it is seen. Append _check_review_stow_in_view_of_a_patrol. Owner's call.

findings.title: GDD 9.6, 'the next fork sign also shows the next boss modifier' (built in M7, D-046), is established by no test of the suite
findings.where: /home/user/I99/.claude/worktrees/wf_99cd96aa-b0b-4/src/core/drive_sim.gd:801-803 (_leave_stop), 1664-1667 (_signs_in_view), 1112 and 1176 (the save's boss_sign). In /home/user/I99/.claude/worktrees/wf_99cd96aa-b0b-4/tests nothing names boss_on_sign, boss_sign or modifier_ahead.
findings.gdd: GDD 9.6: 'Tea stall | Sets Nerves to 30; refills the tea; the next fork sign also shows the next boss modifier'. D-046: 'after tea ... the next fork's sign carries boss and boss_modifier ... It is one sign: taking the fork clears it. The save keeps it (boss_sign)'.
findings.evidence: Two changes run against the WHOLE suite (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-tests/log_full.txt): `run.boss_on_sign = true` replaced by `pass`: 'ALIVE: Ran 114 of 114 tests in 694.9 s: PASS 92, FAIL 0, NEW 0, TODO 0, PEND 22 | RESULT: OK'; restore() no longer reading boss_sign: 'ALIVE: Ran 114 of 114 tests in 1094.6 s: PASS 92, FAIL 0 ...'. The build itself does it (probe /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-tests/probe_tea_sign.gd): 'seed 7: after tea the fork's sign: boss 'checkpoint', boss_modifier 'long_queue''; 'one fork later the sign has the boss on it: false'.
findings.failure: The tea stall's third service is the only way a player learns of a Long queue, a Thorough soldier, a Crosswind or a Night storm before he is in it. It can be lost by any later change with every test green.
findings.fix: Append _check_review_tea_sign (before tea the fork's sign has no boss; after tea it names the Checkpoint and the modifier RunGenerator.boss_modifier gives, in a Telling that has one; the fork after that shows none). It passes on 2940233. Add boss_sign to the round trip of T-SAVE-01.

findings.title: No set piece is ever run under Focus, and which clock the soldier goes by is not decided
findings.where: /home/user/I99/.claude/worktrees/wf_99cd96aa-b0b-4/src/core/drive_sim.gd:466 and 650; /home/user/I99/.claude/worktrees/wf_99cd96aa-b0b-4/src/core/boss_sim.gd:511-513. The word focus does not occur in /home/user/I99/.claude/worktrees/wf_99cd96aa-b0b-4/tests/test_boss.gd.
findings.gdd: GDD 7.4, Energy drink: 'Focus for 30 s: the road runs at 85% speed while the hand runs at full speed'. D-046: 'Focus slows it with the rest of the road'. D-047: the Call rings 'of his own time (Focus does not slow it)'. D-048 says nothing of Focus.
findings.evidence: Four mutants pass all four tests: #17 `boss.step_traffic(_road_dt)` -> `(DT)`; #19 `_step_soldier(cabin_dt)` -> `(dt)`; #33 `boss.step_road(_road_dt, DT, ...)` -> `(DT, DT, ...)`; #56 `_step_call(cabin_dt)` -> `(dt)`. What the build does (probe /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-tests/probe_seams.gd, part F, road_speed 0.85): 'without Focus: the soldier reaches the window after 10.00 s; the first +10 of delay after 5.00 s; the middle lane's queue is gone after 43.7 s; the Storm's first thin spell lasts 8.00 s; the phone rings for 8.00 s'; 'with Focus: ... 10.00 s; ... 5.00 s; ... 51.5 s; ... 9.41 s; ... 8.00 s'. So under Focus the queue slows down and the soldier who walks along it does not.
findings.failure: An energy drink before a boss is an obvious play. If a later change put the soldier's 10 s or the Call's 8 s on the road's clock, Focus would buy 18% more hand time to stow and to answer; if the dust or the queue left it, the road would run at two speeds. Nothing would fail.
findings.fix: Record in DECISIONS which clock the soldier's walk and the delay go by. Append _check_review_focus_checkpoint, _check_review_focus_storm, _check_review_focus_call (they pass on 2940233 and kill #17 'expected 1.17647 within 0.02, got 1.0', #19 'expected 1200, got 1412', #33 'expected 9.41176..., got 8.0', #56 'rings for 8 s of his own time (9.41 s)').

findings.where: /home/user/I99/.claude/worktrees/wf_99cd96aa-b0b-4/src/core/boss_sim.gd:708-711 (papers_passed); /home/user/I99/.claude/worktrees/wf_99cd96aa-b0b-4/tests/test_boss.gd:674-701 (forged papers at a plain Checkpoint only) and 730-760 (Thorough without them); /home/user/I99/.claude/worktrees/wf_99cd96aa-b0b-4/tests/test_deals.gd:45-60
findings.gdd: GDD 7.7: 'Forged papers | Passes the next checkpoint's Papers phase automatically'. GDD 10.2: 'Thorough (two documents)'. D-048: 'Forged papers pass the phase the moment it begins and are gone'.

findings.title: Turned back: the check of first gear cannot fail, and nothing looks at what is left of the old queues
findings.gdd: GDD 10.2: 'At 100 he is turned back: 30 game minutes and the queue again'. D-048: 'the car at the start of the Checkpoint's road again in first gear, a new queue, Suspicion from 0'.
findings.evidence: Mutants that pass all four tests: #11 (`gate.reset(start_gear)` removed from _turn_back), #24 and #25 (_begin_queue no longer removes the vehicle last waved on, or what is left of the old queues), #12 (no suspicion_changed event at the turn back; nothing listens to it yet). Line 606 cannot fail: _follow_the_queue had put the lever in first before the verdict. Against the appended checks: #11 'turned back, he is in first gear again whatever gear he had waited in: expected 1, got 3'; #24 'nothing of the old queues, nor what was waved on, is left on the road: expected 0, got 2'; #25 'a new queue stands in each lane that had one: expected 12, got 20'.
findings.failure: While he waits at the window the lever is his to move. Turned back with it in third, he would be set down at the start at 40 km/h in third gear and run up to 100 km/h toward the new queue. Old vehicles left standing under new ones would show as cars inside cars in the other lanes.
findings.fix: Append _check_review_turned_back_gear (the lever moved to third while he waits, then turned back: first gear, no faster than first gear goes) and _check_review_turned_back_leftovers (turned back while the other lanes still queue: exactly the plan's vehicles stand, nothing else is on the road, suspicion_changed says watching).

findings.title: Nothing checks that a Telling's boss is laid out by the Telling's seed, or that its draws have their shares
findings.gdd: GDD 1.3: 'Randomness: Only from seeded streams owned by the simulation.' D-046: 'one of its two, each as likely as the other, by the Telling seed'; gusts 'from either side by the seed'. D-048: 'types drawn into the plan by the boss seed'.
findings.evidence: Alive: #18 (_begin_boss plans every boss with seed 1 in place of RunGenerator.boss_seed(run.seed, run.act)): it passes the four tests and also T-RUN, T-REPLAY, T-SAVE, T-CLOCK, T-STOP ('Ran 6 of 114 tests ... PASS 6', /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-tests/log_wider.txt); #35 (boss_seed drops the act: the three bosses share one seed); #1 (every queue vehicle is types[0]); #32 (nine gusts in ten from the right); #36 (which of the two modifiers follows the roll for whether: 75 to 25 in Act 1); #39 (every tail light at 70 km/h). Of a Telling's boss the tests compare the modifier only (lines 786, 1589, 2154); line 122 compares the queue with the plan the same code made; lines 773, 1216, 2023 only ask that both values come up; the even split of the two modifiers is checked for the Storm alone.
findings.failure: Every Telling could meet the same soldier asking for the same document behind the same queue, the same gusts and tail lights, the same Dawn traffic, or the Checkpoint's draw could decide the Storm's and Dawn's, with all 114 tests green.
findings.fix: Append _check_review_plan_by_seed (six Tellings driven to the Checkpoint: the plan's documents and queue are those of BossSim.plan with RunGenerator.boss_seed(seed, 1); not all six alike; the three acts' seeds differ; more than one kind of vehicle queues) and _check_review_shares (gust sides and each boss's two modifiers within 4 sigma of even; tail-light speeds across their range). They kill #18, #35, #1, #32 ('24 of 280'), #36 ('301 of 393'), #39 ('70.0 to 70.0 km/h').

findings.title: The Checkpoint is only ever driven in the middle lane
findings.gdd: D-048: 'He is first in line when no queue vehicle of his lane is left ahead and he stands (1 km/h or less) within 8 m of the bar'. GDD 10.2, phase 1.
findings.evidence: Mutant #23 (`var lane: int = 1` in _first_in_line: the middle lane's queue decides whatever lane he is in) lives: all four tests pass. The build is right (probe /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-tests/probe_seams.gd, part E: 'driven in lane 0: first in line true after 57.1 s (queues left 0/0/0), hits 0'; lane 2: 56.3 s).
findings.failure: Two of the three lanes a player may choose are untested: a change that left him waiting at an empty bar on the left, or checked behind a vehicle of his own lane, would not be seen.
findings.fix: Append _check_review_other_lanes (the queue followed in lanes 0 and 2; at the bar of an empty left lane with the middle lane still queuing he is first in line at once; behind the one vehicle of the left lane with the middle lane empty he queues). Kills #23: 'at the bar of an empty left lane he is first in line at once, though the middle lane still queues'.

findings.title: The verdict's edges: exactly 60 cash, what a search takes, what a wrong document costs
findings.gdd: GDD 10.2: 'Banknotes handed through the window (60 cash) pass at any level'; 'From 50 to 99 he is searched: 15 game minutes and contraband is taken'. D-048: 'The wrong document is refused and costs only its time.'
findings.evidence: Alive: #10 (`if cash <= price`: a man with exactly 60 is refused); #26 (a search also sets his cash to 0); #30 (a wrong document adds 50 Suspicion). The bribe is tried with 75 and with 59 cash, never with 60; after a search only the flask and the cigarettes are looked at; and the Papers check at line 486 asks only that the verdict has released: true, which a search has as well as a pass.
findings.failure: The 40 cash he starts with and 20 earned are exactly the price: that player could be refused. A search could cost more than time and contraband, and a wrong document more than its time, unnoticed.
findings.fix: Append _check_review_bribe_exact, _check_review_search_takes_only_contraband and _check_review_wrong_document (after a wrong document his Suspicion is the delay's and nothing more; the right one then ends in paid 'pass'). They kill #10, #26 ('a search takes no cash: expected 77.0, got 0.0'), #30 ('expected 0.0, got 50.0').

findings.title: What the views draw of the Checkpoint (phase, the soldier's walk, the bar, the sign) is checked at its first value only
findings.gdd: GDD 1.3: 'Views read snapshots and never change state.' D-050: 'His own goes up when he is let through'; the soldier 'walks to the car during the Stow, and stands beside the front wing for the Papers'.
findings.evidence: Alive: #14 (`'bar_up': false`), #15 (checkpoint_phase always QUEUE), #16 (stow_left always stow_s), #9 (release() no longer clears `wanted`: after a bribe the sign stays up), #13 (no suspicion_changed when he is let through). The tests read bar_up only where it is false (lines 75, 610), the phase only at the start (line 70), stow_left only at its first value (line 366).
findings.failure: On screen the bar would stay down while he drives through it, the soldier would never leave his post or never come nearer, his sign would stay up after he took the banknotes: all with the simulation right and the tests green.
findings.fix: Append _check_review_checkpoint_snapshot (the snapshot's phase is STOW, PAPERS, THROUGH in turn; stow_left is half gone after 5 s; bar_up and no sign after the document; the event) and the two snapshot lines of _check_review_bribe_exact. They kill #14, #15 ('expected 2, got 1'), #16 ('expected 5.0, got 10.0'), #9 ('expected , got registration'), #13.

findings.title: Hits at their edges: bump_kmh, the immunity, the forced gear, the room between the barriers
findings.gdd: D-048: 'met at more than 5 km/h it is a barrier touch'. D-047: 'met at more than 5 km/h it is a hit of the class of that speed'. GDD 5.6: 'cannot be hit again for 0.8 s'; 'Crash | ... | Forced into first gear'. D-046: 'The hit is a crash (two lamps, +20 Nerves, first gear)'. GDD 10.2: 'barriers 2.34 m apart (1.3 car widths)'.
findings.evidence: Alive: #3 and #47 (bump_kmh times 3: the bar and the street's end are hits only above 15 km/h; the tests try 4 km/h and first gear's 40); #34 (Collision.strike ignores the immunity, so the bar or what comes from behind lands while a scrape still protects him); #43 (a hit from outside the traffic forces no gear: T-BOSS-02 checks a rear-end crash's lamps and Nerves, not the gear); #91 (the barriers reach 10 cm into the corridor, 2.14 m for the car: the tests overlap a barrier by 5 cm or keep the middle, never just inside).
findings.failure: Rolling into the lowered bar at 10 km/h, being hit from behind half a second after a scrape, staying in third gear after that crash, scraping a barrier with 9 cm to spare: each breaks a written rule and passes.

findings.title: Expectations written as literals where the number lives in data
findings.gdd: docs/CLAUDE.md: 'read its numbers from tuning or data, not from literals of its own'. GDD 1.4, rule 4: 'change the value in tuning.json, keep the test reading from tuning'.
findings.evidence: From a grep of the file and reading each line: 716 `1.5 if modifier == 'long_queue'` (data: boss_modifiers long_queue queue_mult); 728 the bounds 1.4 and 1.65 around it; 1467 `* 1.5` (crosswind gust_mult); 1994 `1.3` (market_day traffic_mult); 2436 `10.0` (talk_s x clock_scale / 60); 1674 `0.6` (the next line reads the data); 698 `add(60.0)` expecting a search; 547 the levels 49, 50, 99, 100 and 625 the levels 0, 70, 100 (pass_under, turned_back_at); 162 six seconds of slack. Each stands beside a check that pins the data to the GDD's number (line 708, for one), so a change of tuning fails twice; at 547 and 698 a change of pass_under would not fail but would stop trying the edge.
findings.failure: The tuning pass of M11 cannot move one of these numbers without editing a test, which the rules forbid; and two of them would go on passing while no longer testing 'under 50'.
findings.fix: Append the same expectations read from data: the modifier records' queue_mult, gust_mult and traffic_mult; levels built from pass_under and turned_back_at (pass_under - 1, pass_under, turned_back_at - 1, turned_back_at).
